names: Mission Creek Park South Extension, Parcel P2
search_aliases: Mission Creek Park South Extension -- P2 segment
summary: P2 is one of two parcels (P2 and P8) of the planned Mission Creek Park South Extension; Rec and Park's schematic design keeps the existing Huffaker Park and expands the existing community garden at P2's west end, and the department's page gives construction as starting late 2026 or early 2027.

milestones.text: Hoodline, published April 6, 2018, says a Mission Creek houseboat resident "makes up for it by getting involved at nearby Huffaker Park" (after saying she misses "a real garden with soil"), so a Huffaker Park was in use then. The article does not say where the park is. Rec and Park's schematic design (undated) calls Huffaker Park "existing" and says it "will be preserved and incorporated into the park design", and gives "The existing community garden is 11,500 square feet." It also says "the existing Huffaker Park path will remain in the same location and width while the paving material will be required to be improved to city standards". The date is the article's, which shows the park in use; it is not the date the park was built. The park stands today but is not at its final size: the planned extension builds around it and may rework part of it. No City page found says in its own words that the park is open today.

Construction expected to begin 'Late 2026 / Early 2027' for the Mission Creek Park South Extension (parcels P2 and P8), per Rec and Park's project page, which gives the public opening as 'TBD'; a July 2025 update said construction was expected to begin in 2026 with an 18-month duration

facts.value: 5.7 additional acres of new open space west of the Mission Creek Park Pavilion (the whole final segment, not P2 alone)
Design and construction fully funded through OCII (no amount stated on the page)
San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department, which will own and operate the park on completion
11,500 (existing garden, per the schematic design; it proposes a larger expanded garden at the west end of P2)
Phase II Future Park in the December 2015 Long-Range Property Management Plan (estimated lease termination 2019, a date that has passed)

open_questions: What stands on P2 today? Rec and Park's schematic design describes an existing Huffaker Park (path to be kept, paving to be brought up to city standards) and an existing community garden of 11,500 square feet at P2, but the planned Mission Creek Park South Extension on P2 and P8 is not built (construction expected late 2026 or early 2027), and OCII's 2015 plan lists P2 as 'Vacant Lot/Land'. Whether the whole parcel counts as an existing park is not clear from the sources read.

The schematic design is undated; its one dated item is a plan sheet of June 23, 2006, so the 'existing' conditions it describes are as of an unknown (probably 2000s) date. The only dated source that shows a Huffaker Park in use is Hoodline, April 6, 2018 ("getting involved at nearby Huffaker Park"), which does not say where the park is and does not mention the community garden; no source read dates the garden. The February 10, 2022 Citizens Advisory Committee overview deck could not be read (connection reset) and is not cited.
No construction cost, opening date, designer or contractor was found.
